name: Chain-of-Verification (CoVe)
executive_summary: Draft an answer, generate independent fact-checking questions about it, answer those questions independently, then revise the draft in light of the answers.
description: Decouples verification from the context that produced the original error: the verification questions are answered without seeing the original draft's reasoning, which prevents the model from simply rationalizing its own mistake. Reduces hallucination on fact-heavy generation tasks (e.g. listing entities) relative to plain generation.
when_to_use: Fact-heavy generation tasks (lists of entities, biographical facts) prone to hallucination.
when_not_to_use: Purely creative or subjective generation with no checkable factual claims.
known_pitfalls: Verification questions answered by the same model family can inherit the same knowledge gaps as the original draft.

primary_source.authors: Dhuliawala, Komeili, Xu, Raileanu, Li, Celikyilmaz, Weston
primary_source.title: Chain-of-Verification Reduces Hallucination in Large Language Models
